title: Spell Unbound is Next Fest Ready!
author: AlkrssveGames
selftext:
Hello all! We are excited and ready for Next Fest with an update to our Demo!

To start, you can finally see The Descent all the way to the end! *With some secrets along the way!* Also, now that all 5 acts are available there is a new person for you to find and rescue when you dive into what lies below.

Ossian, The Effigist is waiting for you past Act 3. Once you manage to bring him back to The Sanctum, you'll finally be able to put all of the Effigies you've been gathering across your past runs to good use! You might be wondering how, and the answer is by upgrading your characters!

Whether it be upgrading The Rogue, making crits easier and deadlier; The Witch, empowering her capabilities with a tight loops eventually turning the slow they apply into a snare; or The Channeler, who's pension for damage increases the longer you hold your line and prevent it from snapping.

We hope you'll check out our game and share your thoughts with us!

We hope you will check it out on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5037500/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=organic_post) or [Itch.io](https://alkrssve.itch.io/spell-unbound), and give us a wishlist!

comments.author: TGG_brian
comments.body:
https://preview.redd.it/0wiuy429ngwh1.png?width=1868&format=png&auto=webp&s=e85adbdbe9a627b028d5b79f981d0e0c360b64c4

Playing it now! Very cool. Couple of early notes. Going to the ball rolling mechanism so early in the game is an interesting choice. Made it feel like this might be a game with a lot of different mini games within it, not sure if that's something you're going for but that's what my early impression left me with. Also, there are a couple of early objects that have slightly confusing interactions. That silver pod thing in the bottom left looks like the goal of this level, and it was kinda unsatisfying to roll over there and discover that it only gives you the instructions of the level again - similarly with the loot bags in the dungeon levels, I draw a circle around them, click on them, they seem to react, but not give me any loot? Am I missing something there.

Just some minor things, but love the concept!

replies.author: AlkrssveGames
replies.body:
Hey! Thank you so much for checking it out right away!

I can see where you are coming from, we'll have to see if we can maybe move Cairn, the NPC who gives those instructions, so he isn't causing issues or confusion for anybody else.

For the loot bags you mentioned, is it their outline/shadow that makes them look interactable? Or just what they are entirely? We wanted to have some items in the rooms that gave it a little more feel, rather than just being empty. There are usually vases scattered around that you can break for some occasional health or coins in the rooms.
